游戏发售第一天即可免费领取，试玩了几把发现游戏本身还是很适合联机游玩的，你可以和好友组成小队，一起匹配PVP对战，也可以本地联机，和室友们开心大乱斗。 游戏操作比较简单，进入地图后拾取道具，装备后即可提高战斗力，利用场景中各种交互物品（炸弹，陷阱等）取得优势，然后拿下这场大乱斗的胜利！类似于火柴人大乱斗和揍击派对的玩法，节目效果很不错。 局外，则是角色的配色等自定义内容，玩家在游玩这个游戏的过程中会不断解锁新的呆呆人物角色，解锁人物之后就可以尽情自定义自己喜欢的角色了。 目前游戏比较适合和朋友一起开黑，毕竟谁不想在游戏里痛扁自己的好兄弟呢？

[h1]Can We Stop Getting Such Games...[/h1] [b]Key features[/b] [list] [*]Casual [*]Relies on Online [*]PvP focused [/list] [b]Here's Why I Give it a Negative Review[/b] It's a collection of many poorly executed decisions. So they made a game, with a single PvP mode (just kill others or kill in a team), with a shrinking arena. But... => you struggle to find online matches. If you search normally for random players, it can take many minutes. Counter argument - you can play locally or with pre-made teams. => there isn't a lobby browser, nor can you join someone's session in a mid-progress. => rewards system is just F-d up. I'm sorry. Who's idea was to lock the maximum amount to 5??? Explaining! Say, you won a match and got 30 stars. During rewards screen, you get 6 windows with 5 stars in each. Why??? Why not just make a single window with "you earned 30 stars, here's your chests, cosmetics". What's even worse - you can't skip that! All you have to do is spam enter and watch another emote, coloured butt, chest appears on your screen. Seriously, takes several minutes each time! ADD THE SKIP BUTTON TO YOUR GAMES! All other players meantime wait for to get through those unlocks. [b]Forced Servers[/b] I saved the worst decision for the last. [u]Stop forcing games, especially if it's heavily pvp focused, to rely on servers![/u] How did many other games manage to create multi players pvp sessions, with various modes (e.g. entire Serious Sam franchise, which didn't need servers)? Just connection between players. [b]But how is gameplay...[/b] It's alright... few melee and ranged weapons with various effects. They look pretty before you pick them up, e.g. fish sword, froggy bombs, giant spinner and gnome darts, but once you equip them, you don't see them much. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3724322646 With servers gone (June 2026), local play should still be a thing. But that if you want to invite friends to play this extremely casual thing. Will you? With so many more, much better titles which don't rely on servers? Eh.
